title: No-Show Charge Calculation — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
**Fee schedule note, Specimen Collection Appointments.** A home visit recorded as a no-show carries one no-show charge equal to the published no-show fee of 60.00, posted as one assessed no-show fee rounded to the cent; a no-show assesses only the no-show fee, never a trip fee.

## Formation of the charge

The no-show charge is formed in one fixed order: the starting rate — the published no-show fee of 60.00 — and any amount added to it are added together first; any share applied to the charge then multiplies that sum. The no-show charge is rounded to the cent only once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical missed visits)

| Missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Starting rate | No-show charge | Trip fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Booked in service zone 1 | 60.00 | 60.00 | None |
| Booked in service zone 3, with two household members booked | 60.00 | 60.00 | None |

**Points of judgement.**

- A visit is a no-show when the visit record shows it recorded as a no-show — the patient was not present by the end of the arrival grace period.
- The missed visit never carries a trip fee, whatever its zone.
- The published no-show fee is 60.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for every other visit type.
